3) Contract & procurement review  internal procurement sign-off target 7/15  Owner: FinTechCo procurement / Redwood legal: aditya_rao
4) Pilot deployment & performance validation  target completion 7/24  Owner: FinTechCo engineering / Redwood success: marissa_cole
5) Target go-live (customer traffic)  7/31  Owner: FinTechCo product / Redwood account team

Dependencies: security evidence delivery, SSO test accounts, and legal redline turnaround.

Ask: Please confirm whether the milestones and responsibilities look right, and whether the procurement/contract signature target of 7/15 works with your internal calendar. If you prefer an earlier procurement deadline, flag it and we can adjust the MAP and target close accordingly.

Thanks  I attached the MAP draft (v1) so your procurement/legal teams can start reviewing.
